## Ruby Assistant {{VERSION}}

Windows installer for Ruby, a private, local-first voice assistant: a wake word trained on your own voice, on-device speech recognition and synthesis, and a hard memory budget of 500 MB.

### Install

1. Download `Ruby-Setup-{{VERSION}}.exe` below and run it. No administrator rights are needed.
2. Optionally tick **Start Ruby when I sign in to Windows**.
3. Open the settings, go to *Listening* (*Écoute*) and record your voice (about one minute), then say your wake word.

Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unsigned installer: choose *More info > Run anyway*.

### Requirements

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a microphone, and about 1.5 GB of free disk space (the speech models are downloaded on first start).
